s.note: Arthur and his mum watching the talk show every night
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn, shaking often. Pour over 60g melted butter while tossing and season with sea salt flakes. Tip into one big bowl and settle in on the couch for late-night television.

Slice 4 Lebanese cucumbers into spears and pack into a jar with dill and sliced garlic. Pour over 250ml white vinegar heated with 250ml water and a spoon each of salt and sugar. Chill overnight. Serve in the jar with rye crispbread alongside.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and peas.

w.how: Push sticks into 6 apples. Heat 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tbsp vinegar to 150C with red food colouring. Dip and twirl each apple and set on baking paper.

d.how: Stir 240ml bourbon, 120ml sweet vermouth and 8 dashes aromatic bitters with plenty of ice for 30 seconds. Strain into 4 chilled glasses and garnish each with a cocktail cherry.
